# ex: identical comparison of chan types
ex {
	var ch chan int
	F(ch) -> G(ch)
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F(ch chan int) {}
func G(ch chan int) {}

func H() {
	ch := make(chan int)
	F(ch)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -5,5 +5,5 @@

 func H() {
 	ch := make(chan int)
-	F(ch)
+	G(ch)
 }
